options.label: locator-pair
options.what: the hero descriptor back to naming both cities (`Minneapolis math club` -> `Minneapolis–St. Paul math club`)
options.claims: The 2026-11-08 ruling this reverses said the pair form is what makes the pun on the city name readable; the same-day correction said Minneapolis alone is sufficient for the subtitle and the SEO slots. What the pair buys is coverage of the venues the page sources (src/content.json names places on both sides of the metro, and `venueCount` counts them); what it costs is width in an `uppercase` face. Priced so the correction is reversible with a number in hand.
options.surface: Three slots move together and one of them is outside this file: `locator` in `src/components/HeroSection.astro`, `seo.title` in `src/config.json`, and the `<Layout title>` in `src/pages/index.astro`, which is a literal copy of the config string. `scripts/check-copy.mjs` asserts all three carry the same phrase, which is why an option that moves one has to move all three.

options.label: size-2
options.what: the wordmark one display step smaller from `sm` (`sm:text-display-3` -> `sm:text-display-2`)
options.claims: The shipped step, priced in reverse. The rename created the choice: a single 11-letter word at display-2 measured 251px of ink in a 672px column at 1240, i.e. 421px of unused line, and the old three-word name never had that air to spend. Reversing it measures +0 page height at 1240, 390 and 320 and -8px at 640 @measured 2026-11-08 by `npm run round16` - the wordmark would drop from 300.4px to 250.5px of ink and the page would not notice, which is why the step is cheap enough to keep and why the argument for it is the column, not the fold.
options.surface: One class in `src/components/HeroSection.astro`. The step is `sm:`-bounded, which is why the 320 width (already at display-1 for one word) is where a reversal buys nothing.

identity.text: Minneapolis math clubMatheapolisWe meet around a table in a coffee shop or a brewery in the Twin Cities and work through something together - a paper, a proof, a proof assistant, a puzzle with a strange answer. Dates go up on Meetup; most of the arguing happens in the chat between meetings.There is no syllabus, no reading list to keep up with, and no current focus. What the club is pulling on is decided in its own chat, and some of the threads open there are further down this page. Bring a question; you don't need a field.
